items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS CONFIRMED: Right mouse hold = walk to cursor. Left-click or Z = grab. Ctrl or C = crouch. Shift = run. Space = honk. X = flap. A = zoom out. S = zoom in. WASD/arrows = camera control (NOT goose movement). Tab = open controls panel (closes by clicking outside; Escape does NOT close panel).

TUTORIAL ACTIVE: Third step persists: 'bend down to pick things up off the ground (hold Ctrl then press [left mouse icon])' - remains incomplete despite many attempts.

CURRENT STATE: Controls panel displayed (white/cream background) showing keyboard and mouse controls. Panel opened after cursor moved to (0.42, 0.58). Panel did NOT close after clicking outside at (0.1, 0.5) and (0.05, 0.5), or pressing Escape. Goose partially visible in green game background behind panel.

OBJECTS VISIBLE (before panel opened): Yellow/green curved object at ~(0.42, 0.58). Red/orange mushroom objects at bottom-left. Blue/purple flowers at right. Gray rocks on sides. Brown dirt patches. Wooden stile ramp structure in center.

FAILED STRATEGY: Executed Ctrl+left-click on multiple ground objects (tennis ball, white/gray objects, red/orange mushrooms, yellow/tan objects, yellow/green objects, white/gray objects at various positions). Pattern observed: targeted objects consistently disappeared after Ctrl+left-click, but goose beak remained empty every time and tutorial persisted. Exception: Once goose briefly held orange/red carrot in beak after Ctrl+left-click, but carrot disappeared after 1-second wait. Tried walking goose closer to objects before Ctrl+left-click - no change in outcome.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESIS: Ctrl+left-click causes objects to disappear but does not complete pickup action that satisfies tutorial. Controls panel confirms 'Z grab' and 'left mouse grab' as separate entries, and 'Ctrl C crouch' as separate entry. Tutorial instruction 'hold Ctrl then press [left mouse icon]' may require different execution than simultaneous Ctrl+left-click. Possible interpretations: (1) hold Ctrl continuously, then press left-click separately while Ctrl still held, (2) crouch first with Ctrl, release Ctrl, then left-click, (3) use Z key instead of left-click while holding Ctrl, (4) pickup mechanic requires goose to be in specific position/state relative to object that has not been achieved.

NEXT ACTION NEEDED: Close controls panel (method unknown - clicking outside and Escape both failed) to return to game and continue tutorial attempts.
